marketing_description: The DeWALT DCN930B framing nailer is a 20 V tool powered by a MAX XR Lithium-Ion battery with a brushless motor for extended runtime and durability. It features a nail capacity of 58, accommodating 30 ga stripped clipped head nails with diameters from 7/62 to 0.131 in and lengths from 2 to 3-1/2 in at a 30 deg magazine angle. The unit includes selectable bump and sequential actuation modes, tool-free depth adjustment, a dry-fire lockout, and an integrated rafter hook housed in a black and yellow ergonomic soft grip design.
